title: Origin
appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV, in English or Arabic: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Lighter on your TV: ORIGIN hands memory back to the TV at once: when a film starts, when you leave it, and when you press Home.
Plug in a drive, that is all: A new USB drive is checked in seconds and torrents buffer on it by themselves. An SSD works best.
Your subtitle languages, every time: Found whatever way an addon names the language. Your second language steps in when the first has none.
